module pin 92. DIFFERS: CM4 RUN_PG bidirectional, 10k pull-up to 3.3V; high = running; drive low (via 220R) to reset. CM5 PWR_Button, 10k pull-up to 5V(!): short low = power on/off request, >5s low = force off. Use open-drain/button only.
module pin 93. nRPIBOOT: 10k internal pull-up to 3.3V. Low during boot = USB (rpiboot) boot. Must be low within 2ms of 5V rising. IO boards: jumper to GND only.
module pin 94. DIFFERS: CM4 AnalogIP1 (MXL7704 ADC input, 100nF on module). CM5 CC1 of USB-C power connector (5V/5A PD negotiation).
module pin 95. Active-low power LED output, must be buffered per both datasheets. CM4IO: 74LVC1G07 buffer. CM5IO Rev2: LED+1k direct from +3.3V (buffer removed).
module pin 96. DIFFERS: CM4 AnalogIP0 (MXL7704 ADC input). CM5 CC2 of USB-C power connector.

module pin 99. Same function, renamed. Input, 100k internal pull-up to +5V. Low = lowest-power off state. Pull low >1ms after shutdown to restart (CM4). Drive open-drain only.
module pin 100. DIFFERS: CM4 nEXTRST output (low in reset, high once CPU boots; CM4IO drives USB hub RESET_N). CM5 CAM_GPIO1 (RP1 GPIO35), 15k pull-up, driven low during boot to emulate nEXTRST.
module pin 101. USB_OTG_ID input, internally pulled up (=device). Ground = host. CM4IO: 2.2k pull-down, 2.2k pull-up from micro-USB VBUS. CM5IO: to J2 pin 10 (jumper to GND pin 9).
